name: entity_role_swap
spec_family: Entity and role swaps.
note: Both names and the object are verbatim in S1, so G06 PASSES. This fixture is the reason G07 exists: the actor/predicate/object binding fails even though token containment holds.

name: predicate_transfer
spec_family: Predicate/property transfer between entities.
note: Every protected token is present in the single cited sentence and no template matches, so V1 is honest and asks for review rather than claiming it can tell 'cron runs at' from 'window opens at'.

name: quote_splicing_nonadjacent
spec_family: Citation synthesis across sentences or documents.
note: S1 and S3 are not adjacent; the 1-3-adjacent-IDs rule is a type check, not a judgement call.

name: quote_splicing_adjacent
spec_family: Citation synthesis across sentences or documents.
note: Adjacent and legal, but no single cited sentence covers every protected token, so the union-only claim is Synthesis, not a Primary.

name: negation_clipping
spec_family: Negation, double negation, exceptions, and conditionals.
note: The whole-sentence contract already handed the gate the 'unless' clause: sub-span qualifier clipping is impossible under sentence IDs.

name: possibility_modality_dropped
spec_family: Possibility or desire upgraded to fact.
note: 'might' in the source, no modality marker in the statement.

name: possibility_completed
spec_family: Possibility or desire upgraded to fact.
note: Completed-state upgrade of a possibility; S3 explicitly says nobody decided. Typed 'fact' on purpose so G07's decision templates cannot preempt the G08 finding.

name: planned_to_completed
spec_family: Planned or attempted work upgraded to completed work.
note: S2 supplies a nearby completed verb ('finished') to bait the mistake.

name: historical_to_current
spec_family: Historical fact upgraded to current fact.
note: Time-scope marker ('used to', 'before') present in the source and lost in the statement. The correct memory is in S2 and is not proposed.

name: literal_mutation_clock
spec_family: Date, timezone, number, sign, version, and unit mutation.
note: Guide §6.4-§6.5 verbatim: the model read 03:30 and wrote 03:00. No alias table entry can ever equate two clock times. G07-G12 must NOT run.

name: literal_mutation_control
spec_family: Date, timezone, number, sign, version, and unit mutation.
note: The control half of the same envelope: one bad proposal must never poison a good one. Decision class ⇒ human review regardless.

name: forwarded_speech
spec_family: Quoted speech, forwarded email, pasted logs, and multi-speaker text.
note: The user's message role is real; the belief inside it is John's. Quote markers in the Primary sentence are the trigger.

name: assistant_as_user_belief
spec_family: Assistant/tool/file/web text misattributed to the user.
note: CLASS_POLICY_V1: decision requires FirstPartyUser+Direct. The claimed role is honest here and still fails — the role POLICY is the boundary, not role honesty.

name: wrong_scope_unknown_key
spec_family: Wrong brain, room, project, session, turn, or object.
note: Under schema v2 the model cannot author an action or an object at all. The real V1 shape of this attack is an extra key, and serde deny_unknown_fields kills the WHOLE envelope, not just the candidate.

name: wrong_scope_bad_action
spec_family: Wrong brain, room, project, session, turn, or object.
note: No wire output can express this, so the fixture is a hand-built Candidate injected after G00 — it exercises the allowed_actions check itself, which must not depend on the wire schema staying narrow.

name: wrong_scope_cross_brain_object
spec_family: Wrong brain, room, project, session, turn, or object.
note: Synthetic object reference outside the request allowlist.

name: unrelated_span
spec_family: Valid sentence ID with an unrelated sentence.
note: The claim is TRUE of the unit (S2 says so) and the cited ID is real. Anchor-share with S1 is 0, so correlated evidence rejects at G04 before G06 ever looks at literals — the Deterministic-Quoting residual.

name: unicode_absent_id
spec_family: Defensive sentence-table UTF-8 boundaries plus whitespace/Unicode and preserved-CRLF ambiguity.
note: S9999 satisfies the anchored pattern and exists in no table. Emoji (4-byte), a combining acute, a precomposed diaeresis, an NBSP and a preserved CRLF are all in the unit: expected_render.txt pins the segmenter's answer so a boundary regression is loud.

name: unicode_malformed_id
spec_family: Defensive sentence-table UTF-8 boundaries plus whitespace/Unicode and preserved-CRLF ambiguity.
note: DIVERGENCE (resolved): guide §7.1 routes both 'S0' and 'S9999' to G02. Under the anchored pattern ^S[1-9][0-9]{0,3}$ 'S0' is unreachable by construction from a grammar-constrained model, so a hand-built 'S0' is an ENVELOPE violation (G00), never an evidence-resolution failure. Split into two cases so neither guarantee can rot silently.

name: mutable_prefix
spec_family: Mutable transcript prefix and missing source.
note: Capture hashes transcript.jsonl; replay opens transcript_mutated.jsonl (truncated AND rewritten, so both the length and the digest move). reopen_verified must report PrefixMismatch and the unit must defer — never read the newer bytes. Retries exhausted ⇒ EvidenceVanished tombstone on the evidence_key. No model call ever happens.

name: prompt_injection_assistant_role
spec_family: Prompt injection in every source role.
note: Injection detection stays advisory; the role POLICY is the boundary and the provider is tool-less, so the instruction has nothing to actuate.

name: prompt_injection_role_forged
spec_family: Prompt injection in every source role.
note: Same citation, claimed source_role 'user'. The server reads the role off its own sentence table, so the forgery is a mismatch, not a promotion.

name: secrets_cite_redacted
spec_family: API keys, passwords, tokens, private paths, PII, and high-entropy custom secrets.
note: REDACT_V1 fires before the model sees anything and every placeholder is its own sentence with cite_ok=false. Citing one is a hard reject; the model may read the neighbourhood as context and never ground a memory in it. Evidence IDs pinned against expected_render.txt.

name: secrets_leak_in_statement
spec_family: API keys, passwords, tokens, private paths, PII, and high-entropy custom secrets.
note: Statement carries a credential-shaped literal that REDACT_V1 did not match (custom format), proving G09 is a second, independent screen on the OUTPUT rather than a repeat of the input filter.

name: code_symbol_confusion
spec_family: Code symbol, stack trace, and diff confusion.
note: Identifiers are case- and form-sensitive protected tokens; the alias table has no entry that may equate snake_case with camelCase.

name: exact_duplicate
spec_family: Duplicate, contradiction, supersession, merge, and deletion.
note: Re-running the same unit must cost the user nothing: NoOp, no second review card, no new proposal line.

name: contradiction
spec_family: Duplicate, contradiction, supersession, merge, and deletion.
note: Same candidate, different world: the stored engram says Fridays. Every protected token is still verbatim in S1, so the conflict can only be found against existing state — never against the transcript.

name: destructive_action
spec_family: Duplicate, contradiction, supersession, merge, and deletion.
note: V1 has no destructive wire action; injected post-G00 so the lattice's 'destructive shapes always reach a human' rule is tested even though no model can request one today.

name: curator_output_recycled
spec_family: Curator/review output recycled as evidence.
note: The last two wear allowlisted (event_type, capture_method) shapes and are still ineligible — one by curator/ object prefix, one by a derived_from:curator: source ref. The loop is cut BEFORE unit assembly, so the assertion is zero units, not a gate verdict.

name: envelope_empty_object
spec_family: Oversized input, an over-cap opaque code/log/JSON citation, malformed JSON, model timeout, model crash, and corrupted model identity.
note: '{}' is MalformedOutput, NEVER abstention. Abstention is only the schema's explicit branch — settled cross-model finding.

name: envelope_missing_flag
spec_family: Oversized input, an over-cap opaque code/log/JSON citation, malformed JSON, model timeout, model crash, and corrupted model identity.
note: An empty list without nothing_durable:true is a missing required field, not a quiet abstention.

name: envelope_incoherent_abstain
spec_family: Oversized input, an over-cap opaque code/log/JSON citation, malformed JSON, model timeout, model crash, and corrupted model identity.
note: nothing_durable:true with a non-empty list rejects the WHOLE envelope (guide §5.1 / spec amendment 10): the flag is authoritative only when the list is empty.

name: response_truncated
spec_family: Oversized input, an over-cap opaque code/log/JSON citation, malformed JSON, model timeout, model crash, and corrupted model identity.
note: done_reason 'length': the grammar cannot rescue truncated JSON. Unit defers and retries next run; the watermark does not advance past it.

name: response_oversized
spec_family: Oversized input, an over-cap opaque code/log/JSON citation, malformed JSON, model timeout, model crash, and corrupted model identity.
note: Generated at test time rather than committed: 300 KiB of bytes has no business in git. The cap is enforced while streaming, BEFORE any parse.

name: server_busy_backoff
spec_family: Oversized input, an over-cap opaque code/log/JSON citation, malformed JSON, model timeout, model crash, and corrupted model identity.
note: The user's Ollama is shared: 503 backs off 30 s three times, then the unit defers. The run continues; only preflight-class errors abort it.

name: crash_mid_run_replay
spec_family: Oversized input, an over-cap opaque code/log/JSON citation, malformed JSON, model timeout, model crash, and corrupted model identity.
note: Kill between the proposals-append and the watermark write; replay must append ZERO new lines (proposal_id dedupe) and reach the same state.

name: secrets_kv_leak_reaches_g09
spec_family: API keys, passwords, tokens, private paths, PII, and high-entropy custom secrets.
note: The sibling of secrets_leak_in_statement, written to actually REACH G09 (see the Wave 4a divergence table, row 5: that case reorders S7's anchors and dies at G07 instead, so the corpus never exercised the secret screen). Same transcript, same cited sentence, same expected_render: only the statement changes. It preserves S7's anchor order exactly, so G04's correlation test and G07's binding-order test both pass, and its only protected token (-9987) is verbatim in S7, so G06 passes. What it adds is a `secret=` key-value wrapper around the SAME passphrase — a form REDACT_V1 leaves alone in the transcript (the transcript has no `secret=`) but that G09's independent OUTPUT screen matches as key_value_secret. That is the point of the fixture: G09 is a second, independent screen on what the model WROTE, not a replay of the input filter. Note that the bare passphrase alone would NOT trip G09 — 26 chars is under the 32-char high-entropy floor and `passphrase` is not a key_value_secret keyword — which is why the key-value form is load-bearing here.
